findings.issue: The 150 ms search debounce timer is never cleared when the component unmounts; typing a query then clicking a card within the window fires a shallow goto that rewrites the URL while the user is already on /pokemon/:name
findings.suggestion: Own the timer in an $effect (or onMount) teardown: $effect(() => () => clearTimeout(searchTimer)), or guard updateFilters against the route having changed

findings.issue: The ~1025-item species metadata array is re-serialized to the client on every pagination click, since pagination uses plain <a> full navigations (app/src/routes/+page.svelte:115) while only filters use shallow routing
findings.suggestion: Make pagination shallow too, or move species metadata into +layout.server.js so pagination no longer re-runs the load

findings.issue: Every error, including 500s from a failed API fetch, renders 'Not found' in the title and h1
findings.suggestion: Branch on page.status (from $app/state) to show a generic error message for non-404s

findings.issue: All styling lives in one global stylesheet whose selectors (.card a, .type-badge, .filters) are coupled to markup defined in components and routes elsewhere, losing Svelte's scoped-style locality
findings.suggestion: Move component styles into the .svelte files' scoped <style> blocks; keep only tokens and element defaults global

findings.issue: onMount hash-scroll to #moves duplicates SvelteKit's built-in hash navigation handling and only fires on initial mount, not later client-side navigations
findings.suggestion: Delete the onMount block; SvelteKit scrolls to hash targets after navigation, and #moves already has scroll-margin-top set (app/src/app.css:533)

findings.issue: API fetches have no timeout; if the upstream hangs, every request for that resource hangs indefinitely (cache holds the pending promise, not just rejections)
findings.suggestion: Wrap fetch with AbortSignal.timeout(...) and delete timed-out entries from the cache like rejected ones

findings.issue: Form submit reads the search value via event.currentTarget.querySelector('input') instead of reactive state
findings.suggestion: Keep the input in a $state variable bound with bind:value and use it directly in the submit handler

findings.issue: No .gitignore in app/ and the root .gitignore does not cover app/.svelte-kit or app/build, so build artifacts are at risk of being committed
findings.suggestion: Add app/.gitignore with .svelte-kit/, build/ and node_modules/ as the sv create scaffold does

summary: A genuinely modern SvelteKit 3 codebase that reads like the current docs: plugin-based config, #lib subpath imports, defineEnvVars, shallow routing for URL-driven filters, and clean runes-only Svelte 5. The structure is sound — enforced server boundary, small pure helpers, cohesive components — with one real race in the un-owned debounce timer and a few polish items (error page copy, global stylesheet, payload re-serialization on pagination). Merge after one round of small, mechanical fixes.
